title: D.Gray-man — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
Behind D.Gray-man sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. D.Gray-man is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Katsura Hoshino. Set in an alternate 19th century, it tells the story of a young Allen Walker, who joins an organization of exorcists named the Black Order.

The unconscious does not argue with D.Gray-man; it simply acts first. According to the author, most of her ideas for the series came to her while sleeping in her bathtub for six hours. One exception was the second-volume plot, based on a Noh story entitled "Koi no Omoni".
